class Solution {
    public int[] dailyTemperatures(int[] T) {
        int[] ans = new int[T.length];
        Deque<Integer> s = new LinkedList<Integer>();
        for(int i = 0; i < T.length; i++) {
            while(!s.isEmpty() && T[i] > T[s.peek()]) {
                ans[s.peek()] = i - s.pop();
            }
            s.push(i);
        }
        return ans;
    }
}
